caption: The drawing features two wooden objects set against a plain, light-colored background. The upper object is a wooden clapper consisting of two flat, rounded panels attached together, one on top of the other, with two rectangular slats and a handle extending downward from the panels. The handle is smooth and rounded, matching the light brown color of the panels, while the slats are secured with visible hardware. The lower object is a maraca or shaker with an elongated cylindrical handle and a rounded, bulbous head. The handle and head are both brown, with the head showing a darker, mottled appearance. The two objects are positioned diagonally from each other, with the clapper in the upper section and the maraca/shaker below and slightly to the left. The background is uniformly pale with no additional decorative elements.
title: Policeman's Rattle
